scenarios.name: SP1-REV-01 revision call produces a valid ControlStructure

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure JSON with an added responsibility
the revision is run
a revised ControlStructure model is produced
the revised control structure passes foundation validation

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-02 revision call is logged with stage stage_2 and step revision

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure JSON
a run directory for call logging
the revision is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is revision

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-03 revision receives current control structure and critic findings

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure JSON
the revision is run
the user prompt contains the current control structure
the user prompt contains the critic findings

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-04 structural heuristics are re-run after revision

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure JSON
the revision is run
structural heuristics are re-run on the revised control structure

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-05 only one revision attempt is made

steps.text: a critic that identifies unjustified gaps
an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure that still has gaps
the revision is run
no second revision call is made

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-06 no revision when critic finds no unjustified gaps

steps.text: a critic that finds only justified gaps or no gaps
the completeness critic is run
no revision call is made

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-07 structural errors after revision are flagged in run manifest

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with a missing process model part
the revision is run
the structural error is recorded in the run manifest
the pipeline proceeds without a second revision

scenarios.name: SP1-REV-08 revised control structure replaces the original

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with an added responsibility RESP-3
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-3
the final control structure does not lose existing responsibilities

background.text: the STPA system model revision module is importable
a control structure and CriticFindings with unjustified gaps are available
